links.comparator_used: Undefended virtual patient (gpt-4o-mini with no input defense) under direct and indirect instructional contamination
links.outcome: Slot F1 excluding initial greeting (information recovery) and refusal rate under indirect contamination
links.effect: Indirect contamination without defense: slot F1 excl. init 0.489 (95% CI 0.398-0.581), refusal rate 0.047. With sanitizing defense: slot F1 excl. init 0.903 (95% CI 0.880-0.926), refusal rate 0.000. Clean baseline was 0.901. Direct contamination was not substantially harmful without defense (0.927), and the defended direct condition also returned to near-clean levels.
links.quote: Both defended conditions returned to near-clean levels, including indirect contamination plus defense (slot F1 excl. init 0.903, 95% CI 0.880-0.926; refusal rate 0.000).

design_hint: prompt sanitizing defense and threshold-based guards against instruction contamination
